amendments.old: Only on an explicit operator request, reopen ONE DORMANT pi, pi-durable or Claude Code citizen under its OWN garden id, in a visible window in the operator's own tmux session — or, inside herdr, a new herdr tab. The record supplies session, cwd and, for pi, the transcript's model and provider; the only input is the target id (no model override, task or prompt). Claude Code returns as `claude --resume <session id>` without its earlier model or permission flags. This verb submits NO prompt; what the runtime does once back (for Claude Code, unread mail may wake a turn) is not measured; talking to it is still entwurf_v2 fire-and-forget. TWO receipts mean different things: a LAUNCH receipt (a tmux window or herdr tab was made and asked to start the runtime) and an OBSERVATION receipt (pi: the control socket answered under the same id; pi-durable: the started child adopted this call's reservation (not readiness), or not-yet-adopted / reservation-lost; Claude Code: a NEW live process in this call's window or tab re-armed the session's marker with a fresh binding in the record, or pane-process-unread if herdr reports no pane child; or resume-unobserved, or record-unreadable with its cause). Unobserved is an outcome, not an error to retry; read the visible window. A session a live process holds is refused: a running citizen is reached only via entwurf_v2's rail check; an unadopted pi-durable reservation is not reachable by entwurf_v2. pi-durable reopens only if its session claim is closed and released or its holder is proven gone. Claude Code reopens only if the last validated owner its Entwurf hook armed is proven gone AND that arm is still the record's last; a missing, unreadable, mismatched or unbound marker or an inconclusive owner refuses, and a session held without a committed hook attach is invisible to that proof. Other backends have no same-id resume. This agent itself must run inside tmux or herdr; a herdr launch never falls back to tmux.

amendments.old: Only on an explicit operator request, reopen ONE dormant pi, pi-durable or Claude Code citizen under its own garden id in a visible tmux window — or, inside herdr, a new herdr tab — through the entwurf-bridge (target required; the record supplies the session and cwd — no task or prompt is submitted). Returns the bridge's LAUNCH and OBSERVATION receipts or its named refusal: a session a live process holds (a running citizen, or a pi-durable reservation awaiting adoption), another backend, or a citizen not proven dormant is refused by name, and opening it needs the tmux session — or the herdr pane — this host itself was launched in; a herdr launch never falls back to tmux. Existing unread mail may still wake the resumed runtime; neither receipt proves what it did.
amendments.new: Only on an explicit operator request, reopen ONE dormant pi, pi-durable or Claude Code citizen under its own garden id in a visible tmux window — or, inside herdr, a new herdr tab; in a Herdr Core (hc) terminal, a new terminal on that core — through the entwurf-bridge (target required; the record supplies the session and cwd — no task or prompt is submitted). Returns the bridge's LAUNCH and OBSERVATION receipts or its named refusal: a session a live process holds (a running citizen, or a pi-durable reservation awaiting adoption), another backend, or a citizen not proven dormant is refused by name, and opening it needs the tmux session — or the herdr pane, or the hc terminal — this host itself was launched in; no rail falls back to another. Existing unread mail may still wake the resumed runtime; neither receipt proves what it did.

amendments.old: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside you and hand it a first task. Rail follows THIS agent's process context: inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1), request a NEW UNFOCUSED TAB in your workspace: pi/claude-code via agent start, pi-durable via one native layout request; otherwise use the operator's tmux with all six backends (pi, claude-code, copilot, omp, codex, pi-durable). No fallback: incomplete herdr context rejects by name, never opens unseen tmux. The sibling is asked to call back before its task with the launch nonce; match it and take its garden id from the callback sender envelope. Returns a LAUNCH receipt (owner coordinates + nonce), NOT proof of runtime start, first turn or task delivery. Coordinates are a VIEW, never an address; herdr tab/pane ids can change. Nothing polls. EXISTING citizens: entwurf_v2; entwurf_peers only reports. Model is REQUIRED, passed to runtime CLI: provider/model for pi; id/alias for Claude Code; provider/<exact catalog model id> for pi-durable; pattern for the rest. On tmux, copilot/omp/codex/pi-durable refuse BEFORE window creation if birth, MCP, receive or visible-identity units are absent; pi-durable also refuses installed-carrier/exact-SDK failures; codex needs the operator-owned app-server socket Entwurf never starts. In herdr, copilot/omp/codex reject first; pi-durable runs the same unit/carrier/SDK preflight before layout. Optional placement.tmuxSession is TMUX ONLY: ONE EXISTING session, always wins. Omitted, seat follows the CALLER, not opened backend: a CODEX CALLER opens beside its TUI pane, others in their own session. Missing session: tmux-session-missing, NOTHING is created. Herdr refuses placement by name. No secrets in task: model/task argv are visible to same-user processes.

amendments.old: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside this durable host through the entwurf-bridge and hand it a first task (backend, model and task required; optional cwd and placement). Returns the bridge's LAUNCH receipt or its named refusal — not a started runtime, a delivered task or a reply; the sibling's callback names it. Inside herdr, it requests a new unfocused tab in this host's workspace for pi, claude-code or pi-durable; elsewhere it needs the tmux pane this host itself was launched in.
amendments.new: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside this durable host through the entwurf-bridge and hand it a first task (backend, model and task required; optional cwd and placement). Returns the bridge's LAUNCH receipt or its named refusal — not a started runtime, a delivered task or a reply; the sibling's callback names it. Inside herdr, it requests a new unfocused tab in this host's workspace for pi, claude-code or pi-durable; elsewhere it needs the tmux pane this host itself was launched in. From a Herdr Core terminal it is refused by name and nothing is opened.
